name: actuary
description: Audit Agent Skills against the portable agentskills.io spec, named harness profiles, and authoring best practices. skill-audit produces layered L1 portable-spec / L2 structural / L3 craft findings; with --tier it emits a static Gate-1 verdict gated on privacy/genericization and portable L1 compliance. It does not claim final marketplace readiness.

interface.longDescription: Audit Agent Skills against the portable agentskills.io specification, named harness profiles, and authoring best practices. Produces layered portable L1, structural L2, and craft L3 findings. With --tier it adds privacy/genericization checks and a static Gate-1 verdict for memento:promote; behavioral CI and dedup remain separate final-promotion evidence. Read-only — never modifies the audited skills or executes target content.
defaultPrompt: Audit the skills in this plugin.
Check this SKILL.md against agentskills best practices.
Triage every skill in the toolshed marketplace.
